messages.author: 972e2ef0c27b2b6b
messages.subject: Tabsets + Tooltip
parts:
Hi,

I've added a tabset to an application but notice that the divs in each tab have a title attribute that create a tooltip in each tab. Is there any way to turn off this behavior?

Thanks,
Andee

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Tabsets + Tooltip
parts:
I fixed this last week but we haven't done a CRAN release yet. If you're on R 3.0 or later you can install the latest using devtools:

if (!require(devtools))
  install.packages('devtools')
devtools::install_github('shiny', 'rstudio')
